purpose: Teach: 的中/村長/手抜き/投じ/成し遂げ/はかっ/事由/斡旋

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査予測が的中するように分析されますね
lines.en: The police run their analysis so their investigative predictions hit the mark, don't they.
lines.style: Warm opening observation, genuinely impressed, easy pace with a soft rising tag.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地方の村長と連携した防犯協議もされますね
lines.en: They also hold crime-prevention talks together with the village mayors out in the countryside, right?
lines.style: Conversational and engaged, leaning in slightly, the tag lifting with friendly curiosity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査に手抜きを許さない姿勢で臨まれますね
lines.en: They go into every investigation refusing to tolerate any corner-cutting, don't they.
lines.style: A note of respect firming up mid-sentence, slower on the key phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、予算を多く投じて重点捜査をされますね
lines.en: They pour serious budget into the investigations that really matter, don't they.
lines.style: Mildly awed emphasis on the scale, eyebrows audibly raised, relaxed finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、事件解決を成し遂げた捜査員を表彰されますね
lines.en: And they give commendations to the investigators who actually see a case through, right?
lines.style: Bright approving lift, a hint of a smile carrying through the sentence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場の規模をはかった上で人員配置されますね
lines.en: They size up the scene first, then decide how to deploy their people, don't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured, walking through the logic step by step, nodding along.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査打ち切りの事由は慎重に判断されますね
lines.en: And the grounds for closing an investigation — they weigh those very carefully, don't they.
lines.style: Quieter and more serious, respect deepening, a deliberate pause before the tag.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者支援団体の斡旋もされますね
lines.en: They even handle referrals to victim-support organizations, don't they.
lines.style: Soft concluding warmth, gently impressed, voice settling down to a satisfied close.
